verdict.rationale: The office's public "Forms & Official Fees" page publishes downloadable forms alongside the statutory First Schedule of fees. Filing-process guidance is also published openly on the Basics of Patents page, so a founder can get the forms and orientation material from the site itself. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that downloads require no login, form-specific filling instructions bundled with each form, coverage beyond patents (trademarks, designs, GI forms), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
